FFPF2E.SurrenderedHint: Laid down arms during a FastFighting battle and is at the victors' mercy.

loreBoost.Name: Lore-Collector advantage
loreBoost.Hint: How much likelier a Lore-Collector's rolls against a foe it has sized up are to succeed, for the rest of the turn it spent an action on Recall Knowledge (when the check worked; never without it). 1.25× is a nudge, 3× a sure thing more often than not. Default 2×: Recall Knowledge costs one action of three, and the payoff covers the two left. It matters across the range in PF2e: attacks after the first in a turn carry a penalty, so their odds start low and there is room to raise them.
